headlines.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment right not to testify at Covid hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci declined to answer senators’ questions at a contentious hearing Wednesday on the origins of Covid and the government’s handling of the pandemic, saying he would invoke his Fifth Amendment right to avoid the possibility that Republicans use his testimony to prosecute him for perjury.

headlines.title: Have cyclospora outbreaks peaked yet? CDC reports over 18,000 possible cases nationwide
headlines.description: There are promising signs that illnesses linked to contaminated lettuce may be slowing in Michigan, the hot spot of the multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis in the U.S.

headlines.title: Inside Look at How Men and Women Handle Stress Differently
headlines.description: Whether it’s finances or a looming deadline at work, stress is a natural reaction for everyone, but it can manifest differently for men and women. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar and NBC News medical reporter Dr. Akshay Syal join TODAY to break down the differences between men and women, the toll it takes on the body and what to know about cortisol.

headlines.title: What the New High Blood Pressure Warnings Mean for You
headlines.description: A new study evaluated the current high blood pressure guidelines from the American Heart Association and found nearly one in three adults with high blood pressure may now be eligible for medication to improve their overall health. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar joins TODAY to break down the findings.

headlines.title: How the Cyclosporiasis Outbreak is Hitting Restaurants and Stores
headlines.description: As the multi-state cyclosporiasis outbreak continues to grow, more Americans are shifting their restaurant and grocery shopping habits as a precaution. Four in ten people say they are now buying or eating less produce due to the outbreak, according to a new survey. NBC’s Jesse Kirsch reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: American surgeon restores sight to thousands at war-torn border of South Sudan
headlines.description: An American eye surgeon and his team performed over 1,000 cataract surgeries in Abyei along the South Sudan border, restoring sight to thousands in a region with one of the world's highest blindness rates. NBC News' Molly Hunter reports.

headlines.title: Deodorant for kids: Derms talk the right age for deodorant and the best ones for young skin
headlines.description: Kids are hitting puberty earlier — and needing deodorant sooner. Dermatologists share the best kids’ deodorants for sensitive skin, plus when and how kids should start using them.

headlines.title: Skechers are up to 49% off just in time for your trips to Paris, Rome and other cities with cobblestone streets
headlines.description: Skechers walking shoes are up to 49 percent off right now — they’re perfect for summer travel to cities with cobblestone streets and for all-day comfort at theme parks.

headlines.title: One editor, 16 products, 3 months — my full brand review of Beyonce’s Cécred hair care
headlines.description: I put Cécred’s viral hair care to the test and tried 16 products, including shampoos, conditioners, treatments and more, to see what really lives up to the hype.

headlines.title: The best editor-approved meat delivery services in 2026
headlines.description: We tested steak, chicken, seafood and more from brands like Omaha Steaks, Butcherbox, and Lobsterboys to see which has the best meat delivery service for your next BBQ.

headlines.title: How the cyclospora lettuce outbreak sparked a massive consumer trust crisis
headlines.description: The cyclospora outbreak has people avoiding salads and burrito bowls. Now, for many Americans the question is whether any lettuce can be trusted.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.
